pages.text: Productive Bees stores the bee type in data components. The apiary reads the same data, so it replaces entity hives while adding parallel slots. Search a bee in JEI to see outputs, probabilities, flowers and byproducts.

pages.title: Processing combs
pages.text: Feed combs to the centrifuge. Comb blocks are processed directly and their output multiplier follows the current server setting. A recipe may produce both items and fluids, so route both channels or install the Byproduct Destruction Upgrade only after deciding those byproducts are no longer needed.
